thread:
maya: Quick sync — Needle pilot onboarding criteria. Need clarity on benchmark pass thresholds, pin policy, and customer pricing impact before we open the pilot next Tue.
alex: I can do latency/cost targets. Proposal: p95 <= 220ms at seq512 on Dedicated; target unit cost <= $0.35 per 1k tokens for the recommended quantized variant. :thinking_face:
sam: Bench metric suggestions from ML: embedding cosine >= 0.915 on our seed dataset; chat turn-level BLEU/ROUGE not great proxy, so prefer MRR for reranking > +6% over baseline. Also evaluate hallucination rate <= 2% on the QA slice.
julia: Customer success note — Enterprise pilot customer (AcmeCorp) asked explicitly for a 90-day version pin and monthly performance report. They'll escalate if rollbacks happen without notice.
carla: Recommend a two-path pin policy to balance ops and sales asks:
- soft-pin: default 30d where we auto-notify and schedule a canary before changes
- enterprise-exempt: 90d pin available via contract (manual ops approval)
This keeps the catalog flexible while giving enterprise predictability. :thumbsup:
alex: For rollout, propose this sequence:
1) bench + perf CI (ML) — pass thresholds on seq128/512
2) small-canary (5% traffic, internal tenants) 48h
3) customer-canary (AcmeCorp, sampled workload) 72h
4) GA open to pilot cohort
Snippet for the bench check script we'll use:
```
# run_bench.sh
python bench.py --model needle-v1 --seq 512 --runs 1000 --metrics latency,cost,embed_cos
```
maya: Customer pricing impact — marketing wants a suggested per-call premium for pinned versions. We need an estimate of incremental cost (tokens + infra) for the 90d enterprise-exempt flow.
alex: Rough calc: if Acme does 50M tokens/month on Needle with our unit cost target $0.35/1k -> $17.5k/month COGS. Add reserved capacity uplift ~20% -> ~21k/month. Pricing rec: starting markup 2x for pilot enterprise pin, then revisit with telemetry.
sam: On metrics collection: instrument per-request tags: model_version, pin_status, quant_variant, seq_len_bucket. We'll attach these to Console dashboards; need @eng-infra help for TTL retention.
julia: Also recommend a customer-facing SLA doc with these points: expected p95, pin window, escalation path, monthly perf report. I'll draft the doc.
carla: Escapes and fallbacks: if latency or cost regress >10% vs baseline for 24h, auto-fallback to needle-approx-small and notify stakeholders. Ops runbook should include rollback checklist.
maya: Decision needed by EOD Friday on the pin windows and bench thresholds so we can lock the pilot invite list.
alex: I can own the bench thresholds and CI integration. @sam can you own emb/rerank slices and test harness? @julia can you draft the SLA? @carla pls write the fallback/runbook draft.
sam: I’ll prep the dataset splits and send PR for the bench harness today.
julia: Draft SLA in #product-docs by tomorrow morning.
carla: Fallback runbook draft in the runbooks repo by Friday.
ops-bot: Scheduled: model-deploy-canary needle-v1 -> 2024-05-14T15:00Z (eta: 1h). CI gating required.
maya: Thanks — will summarize action items and share updated timeline in the pilot invite. :rocket:
